en.headline: Police arrest 67-year-old for flying drone in restricted zone in Tin Shui Wai
en.dek: The man was detained on Tuesday night during the temporary no-fly zone set up for the APEC meetings in Shenzhen; a small drone was seized.
body: Police arrested a 67-year-old local man in Tin Shui Wai on Tuesday night on suspicion of flying a drone without permission in a restricted flying zone.
Officers seized a small drone during the operation around 10pm. The man is being detained and the case has been handed to the Yuen Long district crime investigation team.

A temporary restricted flying zone is in force across northern New Territories from early Tuesday until 11:59pm on Friday, in connection with the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen. No drones, paragliders, airships, kites or mass balloon releases are allowed without authorisation.

Police and the Civil Aviation Department reminded the public that unauthorised drone flights can result in a maximum fine of HK$100,000 and two years' imprisonment. This is the second such arrest reported since the zone took effect.

zh.headline: 天水圍67歲男子涉禁飛區放無人機被捕
zh.dek: 警方周二晚上約10時在天水圍拘捕該名本地男子，檢獲小型無人機，案件交元朗警區跟進。
body: 警方周二晚上在天水圍拘捕一名67歲本地男子，涉嫌未經許可在限制飛行區內飛行無人機。
行動中檢獲一部小型無人機，被捕人現正被扣留調查。案件交由元朗警區刑事調查隊跟進。
因應深圳舉行的亞太經合組織會議，新界北部自周二凌晨起至周五晚上11時59分設立臨時限制飛行區，禁止無人機、滑翔傘、飛艇、風箍及放飛大量氣球等活動。
警務處及民航處提醒，未獲授權放飛小型無人機可被判罰款最高10萬元及監禁兩年。這是禁區生效後第二宗相關拘捕。
